description_en: Updates the properties of an Airflow instance
kebab_example: aliyun dms update-airflow --client-token token-0000 --airflow-id af-test0000 --airflow-name testairflow --startup-file default/startup.sh --worker-serverless-replicas 0 --description test_airflow --plugins-dir default/plugins --app-spec SMALL --requirement-file default/requirements.txt --dags-dir default/dags --data-mount-info-list example-string --graceful-shutdown-timeout 60 --enable-serverless true --workspace-id 8630242382800000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAirflow
